description: A self-contained tool module for interacting with a CADAF Cadence Server. Provides an agent-usable CLI for managing workflows.

artifacts.content:
CadenceClientTool:
  CadenceCLI:
    name: "cadence_cli"
    description: >
      The command-line interface to the CADAF Cadence Server. Manages and interacts with workflows.
      Operations:
      - trigger: Starts a new workflow run with specified inputs.
      - list_workflows: Lists all available workflows on the server.
      - get_workflow: Retrieves the definition of a specific workflow.
      - get_runs: Retrieves the history of recent workflow runs.
      - get_run_details: Gets the detailed logs and context for a specific run.
    type: "script"
    runtime: "python3"
    path: "./scripts/cadence_cli.py"
    parameters_schema:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        operation:
          type: "string"
          enum: ["trigger", "list_workflows", "get_workflow", "get_runs", "get_run_details"]
          description: "The command to execute against the Cadence server."
        server_url:
          type: "string"
          description: "Base URL of the Cadence server."
          default: "http://localhost:8000"
        workflow_name:
          type: "string"
          description: "The name of the target workflow (for trigger, get_workflow)."
        run_id:
          type: "string"
          description: "The ID of a specific workflow run (for get_run_details)."
        inputs:
          type: "object"
          description: "A JSON object of inputs for the 'trigger' operation."
      required: ["operation"]
    example_usage:
      - operation: "list_workflows"
        server_url: "http://cadence-server:8000"
      - operation: "trigger"
        server_url: "http://cadence-server:8000"
        workflow_name: "example-user-report-workflow"
        inputs:
          report_title: "Special Agent-Triggered Report"

setup_instructions: 1. Materialize the 'core.cadence_cli.yml' and 'scripts/cadence_cli.py' files into your agent's tool directory.
3. Add the `core.cadence_cli.yml` to your agent's configuration file under the `import.tools` section.

4. The tool will default to connecting to `http://localhost:8000`. This can be overridden with the `server_url` parameter or by setting the `CADENCE_SERVER_URL` environment variable where the agent runs.
